attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Wyoming annual report. Note: Wyoming has NO corporate income tax - no tax return required. Only annual report filing ($60 domestic, $120 foreign).

condition_details.condition_comment: Has presence in Wyoming (incorporated or registered)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "WY" streq } over if

action_details.action_comment: Wyoming domestic corporation - annual report required ($60); Wyoming has NO corporate income tax - only annual report ($60)
action_details.action_dsl: set wy_result.annual_report_fee = wy_result.annual_report_fee_domestic; set wy_result.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; add "Wyoming has NO corporate income tax. Domestic corp annual report: $60. Reference: Wyoming Statutes 17-16-1630" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: wy_result.annual_report_fee_domestic cvd /wy_result.annual_report_fee xdef 0.0 cvd /wy_result.state_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef "Wyoming has NO corporate income tax. Domestic corp annual report: $60. Reference: Wyoming Statutes 17-16-1630" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Wyoming foreign corporation - annual report required ($120); Wyoming has NO corporate income tax - only annual report ($120 foreign)
action_details.action_dsl: set wy_result.annual_report_fee = wy_result.annual_report_fee_foreign; set wy_result.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; add "Wyoming has NO corporate income tax. Foreign corp annual report: $120. Reference: Wyoming Statutes 17-16-1630" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: wy_result.annual_report_fee_foreign cvd /wy_result.annual_report_fee xdef 0.0 cvd /wy_result.state_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef "Wyoming has NO corporate income tax. Foreign corp annual report: $120. Reference: Wyoming Statutes 17-16-1630" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No Wyoming presence - no filing requirement; No Wyoming presence - no filing requirement
action_details.action_dsl: set wy_result.annual_report_fee = 0.0; set wy_result.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments; add "No Wyoming presence - no filing required. WY has no corporate income tax anyway. Any payments refunded." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /wy_result.annual_report_fee xdef 0.0 cvd /wy_result.state_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No Wyoming presence - no filing required. WY has no corporate income tax anyway. Any payments refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Wyoming has NO corporate income tax. This table confirms zero income tax liability for consistency with framework.

condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "WY" streq } over if

action_details.action_comment: Wyoming - no income tax adjustments; Wyoming has NO corporate income tax - no adjustments
action_details.action_dsl: set wy_apportionment.state_tax_rate = 0.0; set apportionment.state_additions = 0.0; set apportionment.state_subtractions = 0.0; set wy_result.no_corporate_tax = true; set wy_result.no_gross_receipts_tax = true; set wy_result.no_franchise_tax = true; add "Wyoming has NO corporate income tax, franchise tax, or gross receipts tax. No adjustments needed." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /wy_apportionment.state_tax_rate xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef true cvb /wy_result.no_corporate_tax xdef true cvb /wy_result.no_gross_receipts_tax xdef true cvb /wy_result.no_franchise_tax xdef "Wyoming has NO corporate income tax, franchise tax, or gross receipts tax. No adjustments needed." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No Wyoming presence - no adjustments; No Wyoming presence - no adjustments
action_details.action_dsl: set wy_apportionment.state_tax_rate = 0.0; set apportionment.state_additions = 0.0; set apportionment.state_subtractions = 0.0; set wy_result.no_corporate_tax = true; set wy_result.no_gross_receipts_tax = true; set wy_result.no_franchise_tax = true; add "No Wyoming presence - no tax liability (WY has no corporate income tax anyway)." to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /wy_apportionment.state_tax_rate xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef true cvb /wy_result.no_corporate_tax xdef true cvb /wy_result.no_gross_receipts_tax xdef true cvb /wy_result.no_franchise_tax xdef "No Wyoming presence - no tax liability (WY has no corporate income tax anyway)." job.audit_trail swap addto
